decimalHint: Digits with a dot for decimals, for example 1250000.50. Leave empty if not known (shown as Unknown, never 0).

validation.label: Finance validation
validation.title: Finance validation: {{name}}
validation.description: Record your Finance decision on the current version of this record. A later change makes the decision stale.

baseline.title: Baselines
baseline.intro: Measured starting points. A baseline counts for G1 only with a value, a source and a baseline date, backed by verified evidence.
baseline.sourceHint: Where the value comes from (system, report, extract).
baseline.emptyBody: Add the measured starting points of the metrics this transformation will move.

valuePool.title: Value pools
valuePool.intro: Where value can be created. A pool without amounts is labelled Unquantified; it is never counted as 0.
valuePool.quantificationHint: Quantified pools need both a downside and an upside amount; unquantified pools need a reason instead.
valuePool.totalNote: Totals add only quantified pools of the same currency, exactly (no rounding). Currencies are never added together.
valuePool.emptyBody: Add the value pools found in the diagnostic, quantified or not.

definition.title: KPI definitions
definition.intro: The KPI dictionary of this transformation: unit, polarity, frequency, owner and steward.
definition.currencyHint: Required for a currency KPI; not allowed for other units.

t02.title: Outcome & KPI Tree (T02)
t02.intro: Each row links an outcome to a KPI with baseline, target and a required target date, plus the target trajectory. Targets are time-bound.
t02.baselineValueHint: Leave empty to use the linked baseline's value.
t02.trajectoryHint: One point per line: date and value, for example 2027-03-31 1250.5. Dates must increase and not pass the target date.
t02.approveDescription: A business approval of this version of the target and trajectory. It is never given by the person who created the row; a later change needs a new approval.
t02.prerequisites: Add an outcome and a KPI definition first.
t02.emptyBody: Link each top outcome to at least one KPI with a dated target.
